hero.title: Your Mac's storage
summary.idle: Press the button below to find space you can reclaim
summary.found: About {size} can be reclaimed (developer tools are counted separately)
disk.note: "Free" is the space you can use right away. macOS may show more because it also counts caches the system can remove on its own when needed.
scan.busy: Scanning... this may take several minutes. Please wait.
card.cache.title: App caches
card.cache.desc: Temporary files created by apps. Safe to delete; apps recreate them when used.
card.big.title: Large files
card.big.desc: Videos, data files and downloads of 100 MB or more. Review before deleting.
card.tools.title: Developer tools
card.tools.desc: Docker, Homebrew, conda, pnpm, npm and pip. The commands to run are always shown first. Docker volumes are never touched.
card.dups.title: Duplicate files
card.dups.desc: Files with byte-for-byte identical content, 10 MB or larger. The most recently modified copy is always kept.
card.fdups.title: Duplicate folders
card.fdups.desc: Folders whose contents are all identical. The most recently modified folder is always kept.

tools.sheet_sub: This is the space each tool's command can reclaim. Nothing is deleted or updated until you press a button.
tools.clean_confirm:
This will clear the caches of Docker, Homebrew, conda, pnpm, npm and pip.

Docker volumes will not be touched.
tools.brew_confirm:
This will update all outdated Homebrew packages (brew upgrade).

It can take a long time. Packages that need an administrator password may fail to update.
tools.brew_busy: Updating... this may take several minutes
